title: Golem Loot
description: Adds a loot table to the Iron Golem, including a powerful item for PvP
body:
# Description Adds a better loot table to the Iron Golem, including a custom item that is useful in PvP. ### Items include: **Common** * Poppy * Iron Nugget * Iron Ingot * Vine * Emerald
**Rare** * Iron Block * Iron Tablet (CUSTOM ITEM, which disables shields for 30 seconds when you attack, similar to an axe but longer) ![Iron Tablet Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54cc2c8c973b54b6ae5d41727e7e9c61c7a74dc5_0.webp) Iron Tablet Drop Rate (Looting 0, 1, 2, 3): 2% | 5% | 10% | 20% ### Resource Pack Required # Versions Supports Java Edition 1.21.5 - 26.2 (anything older is untested)
